environment: Local Colima Denlumi Supabase PostgreSQL 17.6; fictional test records; separate task-owned database in the same local container

attempts.detail: The first restore had 9 Supabase auxiliary Realtime, Vault and event-trigger privilege/concurrency errors. It was not counted as a pass.

attempts.scope: Application public/private/auth schema dump and restore
attempts.detail: pg_dump -Fc for the three schemas; created a separate database from template0, removed its pre-existing empty public schema, and ran pg_restore as local supabase_admin with -j 2. Restore exited 0.

cleanup: Both task-owned restored databases and both temporary dump files were removed; original local database remained in use.
limits: This proves an application-scoped local fictional restore and one restored RLS owner scope check. It does not establish a full Supabase platform disaster recovery, hosted backup retention/erasure, point-in-time recovery, or a timed production RTO.
